Hi Rishi and team,

We're starting our SIG assessment and need a consolidated package of IAM evidence for Redwood's environment as it pertains to our tenant. Specifically we need:

- SAML/SSO configuration (metadata, assertion examples) for the Redwood Console access used by ApolloHealth admins

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Alex

Thanks — this looks good. A few follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm that the SCIM delta file includes deprovisioning events with timestamps and the associated system triggers (e.g., manual deprovision vs. SCIM PATCH by IdP)? We use that to validate timely deprovisioning.

2) For the RBAC matrix, please include a short column that states "business justification" for any role that allows data export or log access. That helps our reviewers.

3) The role_ownership_signoffs.pdf — could you include printed name, title, and a dated signature per role? A scanned sign-off is fine.

Finally, instead of a generic attestation, would Redwood provide a short emailed statement (one paragraph) from product security confirming the organization performs quarterly least-privilege reviews for external-tenanted roles, and that any exceptions are tracked in your compliance Jira (ticket references acceptable)? That will expedite our SIG review.

If you can get the SharePoint link and the 1-paragraph attestation by EOD Monday (10/19), we'll be set.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
